items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Don Weiss (PHONETIC) Byas would wait for him to get drunk.

ctx.x: Yeah. We grew up -- it was like flag and country and Roosevelt. They were all sort of interchangeable.

Yeah. That's the only thing I knew, you know? So in those days with Charlie Parker, we used to discuss quite a bit, you know? In the same bar where Ben Webster used to go and get a drink and Don Weiss (PHONETIC) Byas would wait for him to get drunk.
